name: use-case-personas
title: Use case personas
description: Use-case persona cards with roles, requirements, solutions, and optional animations.
usage: The "who this is for" section of a use case page, inside a `SiteSection`. Pass `story` (a dot story) and its reported `phase` to play the three parts in a demo window.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
